_readme: The site's go-live switches; every page reads this file when it loads (docs/launch/hosting.md). A platform's buttons link to its file only when its live flag is true; until then they say 'Coming soon', so the site can go online first. Flip windows.live / mac.live once the file is on the latest GitHub release of the public spenseay/shoutabout repo (the URLs never change: stable file names, releases/latest), and iphone.live once testflight_url (later app_store_url) is filled in. contact_email: empty = no email anywhere on the site; set it (for example a free Cloudflare Email Routing address) to show it in the footer, on /support and in the privacy policy and terms. size_bytes is optional (shown as 'about N MB').
